name: Normal communication
description: PC-1 opens an HTTPS session to APP-SRV. It is permitted everywhere on the way, so nothing is raised.

presentation.objective: Show that legitimate traffic is allowed and generates no security noise.
presentation.security_rule: STAFF-IN rule 100 permits it; IPS-1 inspects it and finds nothing; no detector fires.
presentation.explanation: The packet crosses ACC-SW2, CORE-SW1 (ACL permit), IPS-1 (clean) and SRV-SW3 and reaches APP-SRV, which answers. IDS-1 sees a SPAN copy and stays quiet, so the SIEM receives nothing.
expected: The session is delivered and APP-SRV answers
No IDS-1 alert and no IPS-1 action
